<!-- Generated from backend/logic/schema.py. Do not edit. Run `hogli build:projections`. -->

| Command                                   | Also      | Works on                             | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ----------------------------------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `@posthog review [--deep] [--no-resolve]` |           | pull requests                        | Start a Standard review of this pull request. `--deep`: Run a Deep review instead of the default Standard review. `--no-resolve`: Don't resolve review comments after a Deep review. By default the pull request owner's setting decides. |
| `@posthog stamp`                          | `approve` | pull requests                        | Ask Stamphog to review this pull request. Stamphog decides whether to approve.                                                                                                                                                            |
| `@posthog qa [<focus>]`                   |           | pull requests                        | Run frontend QA on this pull request in PostHog Code and post a report. `<focus>`: What to focus on. The agent gets it as your instruction.                                                                                               |
| `@posthog loop <name>`                    |           | pull requests                        | Run one of your own Loops with this pull request as its input. `<name>`: The loop's name.                                                                                                                                                 |
| `@posthog resolve`                        |           | error tracking issues                | Mark this error tracking issue as resolved.                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `@posthog assign`                         |           | error tracking issues                | Assign this error tracking issue to yourself.                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `@posthog help`                           |           | pull requests, error tracking issues | List these commands.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
